entries.questionEn: Which NPU device path does my reComputer RK use?
entries.directAnswerEn: The RK3588 uses renderD129 and the RK3576 uses renderD128.
notes: The camera node differs as well.

officialReferences.title: Object Detection with YOLOv11 on reComputer-RK

entries.questionEn: Can the reComputer RK3576 boot the system from an M.2 NVMe SSD?
entries.directAnswerEn: Yes. The engineers confirmed that the reComputer RK3576 supports installing and booting the system from an M.2 NVMe SSD.
entries.appliesTo: reComputer RK3576 series, using an M.2 NVMe SSD as the system disk
